Subject: POC session — week of May 10: technical deep-dive & load windows

Hi Sarah,

Thanks again for the time today. Per our call, we want to lock a set of technical deep-dive sessions the week of May 10 that cover: prompt review (routing & role-based outputs), routing config + fallback policy, and a staged load test (ramp -> soak -> spike). We propose running a 90-minute hands-on window for each region so engineers on both sides can pair:

- US window: 09:00–10:30 PT (UTC-7) — dev pairing + prompt walkthrough
- EU window: 15:00–16:30 CET (UTC+1) — routing/fallback review
- APAC window: 04:00–05:30 AEST (UTC+10) — load test soak (we know this is inconvenient; rotating shifts okay)

Attached is a draft agenda and the preliminary load-test plan. Could you confirm:
1) Which two days that week work best for Orchid engineers?
2) Which region needs to be prioritized for the soak test (you mentioned APAC product owners prefer evening local times)?
3) Any blackout windows we should avoid (on-call, board review, other demos)?

If the APAC window is too early on your side we can rotate the hands-on so APAC gets a later slot on one of the days — we have flexibility but need to finalize invites by EOD Friday.

I'll leave Dev and Hannah on copy for technical constraints and capacity planning.

Cheers,
Rachel

--
Rachel Kim
Sr. Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference

Redwood Inference

Subject: Re: POC session — week of May 10: technical deep-dive & load windows

Hi Rachel,

Appreciate the detailed agenda. Quick answers from our side:

- Preferred days: Tue May 11 and Thu May 13 (we can do either both or pick one for the full set).
- Priority region for soak: APAC (our ops lead will be on-call and can observe) — but we do need the APAC session to start no earlier than 06:00 AEST local time if possible.
- Blackouts: Wed morning (team all-hands) and Thu 08:00–10:00 CET (customer review).

On load: we can run a sustained 50 RPS for soak and a short spike to 150 RPS for 2 minutes. For the US window we can push 75 RPS sustained. We'll confirm exact test accounts and tokens by Friday.

One ask: can Redwood provide a short pre-POC checklist for our infra (allowed IPs, expected headers, rate limit windows) so our platform team can prep?

Thanks,
Sarah

Thanks Sarah — that's helpful. Based on your constraints I've proposed a slightly adjusted rotation to keep the hands-on pairing equitable and to avoid Orchid's blackouts:

Option A (preferred):
- Tue May 11: EU + US combined block (14:00–16:00 CET / 05:00–07:00 PT) — prompt + routing deep-dive, light load ramp at the end (US team can attend early)
- Thu May 13: APAC heavy-lift block (06:00–08:00 AEST) — soak test (50 RPS) and spike windows; Redwood will own traffic generation tooling and provide tokens

Option B (if APAC needs later on Thu):
- Tue May 11: US session 09:00–10:30 PT (paired dev)
- Thu May 13: EU afternoon 15:00–16:30 CET and rotate APAC to Fri morning 07:00–08:30 AEST

Action items for us (we'll handle before invites go out):
- Provide the pre-POC infra checklist (attached: redwood-quick-checklist.md)
- Confirm load runner capacity and token scopes (Dev will validate)
- Send calendar invites with clear timezone labels and expected participants

Can you confirm Option A or B? If we don't hear back by EOD Thursday we'll default to Option A and schedule invites.

Thanks — looping Dev for load-test confirmation.

Rachel
